FAQ

Common Questions

Do I need a gym?

No. The plans work for the gym or for home with minimal equipment.

I'm a complete beginner. Is that okay?

Yes. Everything starts from zero and is explained in simple words.

How fast will I see results?

Most people notice changes in 3 to 4 weeks, with big changes by 12 weeks of consistency.

How do I pay and receive the book?

Message me on WhatsApp and I will share the payment methods and send your files right after.
